resources.string: Your voice is moving to a new engine
So you can practice with a voice that sounds more natural and more like you, we\'re moving your voice to a new voice engine. Replies get faster too.
When it moves, your current voice is deleted and a new one is made from the recording saved on this device. Audio that was already made keeps playing.
From now on your fluent self speaks with your new voice.
There\'s no recording on this device. Record your voice again in Me → Voice to move it.
